title: ducky's special cpvp texture pack
description: This texture pack makes your crystal experience better there is going to be 2 different texture packs uploaded, this one has all types of ores hidden (deepslate,stone) it is hidden in netherite for donut smp or other servers.
body:
This texture pack features:

- No CPVP Sounds
- Custom Glowstone,Respawn Anchors,Crystals & Obsidian
- Small Handheld Items
- Custom Armor/Tools
- Custom Enderpearls
- Custom Totems
- Custom Banner Inside of Inventory
- Custom Fire

Hope you have a good time trying this texture pack out!
